business_model.basis: Stated in P1 (10-K Item 1) and P3 (10-K Item 7 MD&A).
business_model.claim: TWFG is an independent distribution platform that places personal and commercial insurance contracts between insurance carriers and clients, earning commission income that comprised approximately 89% of total revenues in 2025.
quotes: We are a leading, high-growth, independent distribution platform for personal and commercial insurance in the U.S.

business_model.basis: Stated in P1 (10-K Item 1) and confirmed by revenue disaggregation tables in P3.
business_model.claim: The company operates two primary reporting segments: Insurance Services (79% of 2025 revenue, split into Agency-in-a-Box at 62% and Corporate Branches at 17%) and TWFG MGA (20% of 2025 revenue).
quotes: We operate through two primary offerings: (1) Insurance Services, through TWFG's exclusive Branch agreements or what we refer to as "Agency-in-a-Box" (over 550 agencies) and through Corporate Branches (approximately 19 agencies) and (2) TWFG MGA (over 2,750 agencies).
Insurance Services (79% of 2025 Revenue): Branch principals have nearly 18 years of insurance industry experience, on average, with established local relationships and deep ties to their communities.

business_model.basis: Stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Agency-in-a-Box section).
business_model.claim: In the Agency-in-a-Box model, TWFG receives all commission revenue from carriers and subsequently pays a commission expense to each Branch based on the exclusive Branch agreement; the Branch bears its own operating costs.
quotes: Unlike some other insurance distribution models, the operating costs incurred by our Branches do not transfer to TWFG. Instead, we receive all commission revenue and subsequently pay and record a commission expense to each Branch based on the relevant exclusive Branch agreement.

business_model.basis: Stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, Corporate Branches section).
business_model.claim: For Corporate Branches, TWFG retains 100% of commission income and is responsible for 100% of the branch's expenses, including salaries and benefits for employee agents.
quotes: A portion of our Branches are wholly-owned by TWFG. These Corporate Branches were developed organically or acquired from third parties, and we retain 100% of the commission income received from insurance carriers and are responsible for 100% of the Corporate Branches' expenses.

business_model.basis: Stated in P1 (10-K Item 1, TWFG MGA section).
business_model.claim: TWFG MGA facilitates placement of traditional and hard-to-place personal and commercial insurance risks in both Admitted and E&S markets, providing third-party administration, carrier access, and brokerage services to over 2,750 independent MGA Agencies.
quotes: Through our TWFG MGA offering, we facilitate the placement of traditional and hard-to-place personal and commercial insurance risks. We provide access to insurance carrier relationships and products in both the Admitted market and the E&S markets, which are often inaccessible by small agencies.
